blocks.text: Musbat ions tab bante hain jab atoms se electrons hataye jate hain. Sodium ion Na+ (proton number 11) ke 10 electrons hain, to us ki configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6 hai, neon jaisi, jis ke har atom mein 10 electrons hain. Manfi ions tab bante hain jab atoms electrons lete hain. Sulfide ion S2- (proton number 16) ke 18 electrons aur configuration 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 hai, argon jaisi.

Aam taur par jab metal atoms musbat ions banate hain to bairooni subshell ke electrons hatte hain, magar d block anasir thora mukhtalif bartao karte hain. Table mein potassium se zinc tak parhein to 4s subshell 3d se pehle bharta hai, phir bhi jab d block unsur ke atoms electrons kho kar ions banate hain to 4s electrons pehle jate hain. Titanium atom 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d2 4s2 hai aur Ti2+ ion 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d2; chromium atom 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d5 4s1 hai aur Cr3+ ion 1s2 2s2 2p6 3s2 3p6 3d3.

blocks.prompt: O2- (Z = 8), Fe3+ (Z = 26) aur Cu2+ (Z = 29) ki configurations likhein.
blocks.explanation: O2- ke 10 electrons hain: 1s2 2s2 2p6. Iron [Ar] 3d6 4s2 hai; Fe3+ pehle do 4s electrons aur phir ek 3d khota hai, jo [Ar] 3d5 deta hai. Copper [Ar] 3d10 4s1 hai; Cu2+ 4s electron aur ek 3d khota hai, jo [Ar] 3d9 deta hai.

items: Cations electrons khote hain (Na+ 1s2 2s2 2p6, neon jaisa); anions lete hain (S2- argon jaisa). d block atoms 4s 3d se pehle bharte hain magar 4s pehle khote hain: Ti2+ [Ar] 3d2, Cr3+ [Ar] 3d3.
